requirements.title: Qualify and prioritize acquisition leads
requirements.description: Lead records can be scored and qualified using evidence-backed business and digital-channel signals.
technical_verification_criteria: Signal provenance is recorded; unsupported activity is not inferred.
unresolved_questions: Choose an owner-approved score model: revenue-engine baseline, Scoring V2, or current code differ.
Confirm minimum score and non-score qualification hard gates.

requirements.title: Require review before initial outreach
requirements.description: Personalized first-contact messages are reviewed before any customer communication.
business_acceptance_criteria: For MVP: review message, approve, send
technical_verification_criteria: No outbound message is sent without an auditable explicit approval.
Opt-outs and suppression are hard blocks.
unresolved_questions: Does approval authorize draft creation only, or sending? Current Ops policy says it does not execute; WF03/WF05 describe send after approval.

requirements.title: Keep outreach evidence-based and opt-out safe
requirements.description: Do not mass contact unqualified leads, fabricate claims, or continue after refusal; record statuses.
business_acceptance_criteria: Automation mengikuti data nyata, bukan asumsi.
technical_verification_criteria: Message drafts retain source facts and can be audited.
unresolved_questions: Approve provider, consent basis, limits, retry policy, and distinction between review approval and send authorization.

requirements.title: Offer the LP100 landing-page package
requirements.description: Campaign presents the documented Rp100.000 one-page mobile-responsive landing page offer and its stated inclusions.
technical_verification_criteria: Campaign source parameter is restricted to declared values and appears in WhatsApp referral text.
unresolved_questions: Confirm offer is current and approved; define acceptance for conversion, segment coverage, and fulfillment handoff.

requirements.title: Build a testable production landing-page vertical slice
requirements.description: Blueprint lists a vertical slice from project/brief intake through schema rendering and preview.
technical_verification_criteria: install, lint, typecheck, tests, and Docker build pass
unresolved_questions: Confirm Product Factory remains a separate product and reconcile its scope with the shipped AFUZA.ID generator.
